title: 26 CFR 1.461-5, Recurring item exception (4-1-25 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, Code of Federal Regulations

passages.question: Could the recurring item exception change the timing of either provision?
passages.excerpt: occurs on or before the earlier of— (A) The date the taxpayer files a timely (including extensions) return for that taxable year; or (B) The 15th day of the 9th calendar month after the close of that taxable year;
